IdentityFoundationPreview.title: Your business, ready when you are.

Signup.title: Your business, organized from day one.
Signup.description: A few clear steps and you'll be ready to get started.
Signup.cardDescription: Use an email address you can access.
Signup.passwordHint: Use at least eight characters with a mix that is difficult to guess.
Signup.success: Account created. Check your email for the verification code.

Login.title: Good to see you again.
Login.description: Pick up where you left off.
Login.cardDescription: Enter the email and password for your Tunakuza account.

VerifyEmail.title: Check your inbox.
VerifyEmail.description: Your six-digit code is waiting in your email. Enter it to continue.
VerifyEmail.securityNote: Keep this code private. Tunakuza will never ask you to share it.
VerifyEmail.cardDescription: Confirm the email and enter your verification code.
VerifyEmail.resendSuccess: If the account is eligible, a new verification code has been sent.
VerifyEmail.missingEmail: Enter the email address you registered.

Onboarding.title: Set up the essentials for your account.
Onboarding.description: Choose a public username and add your country and phone number so Tunakuza can prepare your account.
Onboarding.cardDescription: You can manage more profile details later.
Onboarding.sessionRequired: Your secure session is unavailable. Please log in again.

PasswordResetRequest.title: Reset your password securely.
PasswordResetRequest.description: Enter your email and Tunakuza will send a reset code if the account is eligible.
PasswordResetRequest.cardDescription: For privacy, the next message is the same whether or not an eligible account exists.
PasswordResetRequest.success: If the account is eligible, a password reset code has been sent.

validation.code: Enter the reset code from your email.

PasswordResetVerify.title: Confirm that you received the code.
PasswordResetVerify.description: Enter the reset code sent to your email. The code is limited and expires for your protection.
PasswordResetVerify.cardDescription: Use the email that requested the reset and its latest code.
PasswordResetVerify.success: Code verified. You can now choose a new password.
PasswordResetVerify.resendSuccess: If the account is eligible, another reset code has been sent.

validation.code: Enter the numeric reset code from your email.

PasswordResetConfirm.title: Create a password only you know.
PasswordResetConfirm.description: After the change, Tunakuza will revoke every existing session and require a fresh sign-in.
PasswordResetConfirm.cardDescription: Use a strong password you have not used for this account before.
PasswordResetConfirm.passwordHint: Use at least eight characters with a mix that is difficult to guess.
PasswordResetConfirm.success: Password changed. All existing sessions were ended; sign in with your new password.

validation.code: Enter the reset code from your email.
